svg.title: Dark Blue Relief
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and standardized vivid palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-diagonal-02-2009/lightbox/works/dark-blue-relief-2008-31223; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.
